risks.title: Raw material risks
risks.score_rationale: The cost of raw materials, such as wood, fabrics and foam products, may vary depending on market conditions, which could impact the company's results. The company is also exposed to transportation cost risks, including container and fuel prices.

risks.title: Inflation risk
risks.score_rationale: Inflation may impact the company's production costs and selling prices, which could affect its results. However, the company has implemented measures to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

risks.title: Commercial real estate risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to commercial real estate market conditions, particularly regarding rental rates and property values. A decline in property values or an increase in rents could impact the company's results.

risks.title: Asset impairment risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to asset depreciation, particularly concerning real estate and lease assets. Asset impairments could impact the company's results.

risks.title: Internal control risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has implemented measures to ensure internal control, but there are still risks related to fraud or error. However, auditors have expressed a favorable opinion on the company's financial statements.
